_comment: Hand-authored fixture in ESPN's athlete-news shape. Field names are taken from the real ESPN payload that scripts/fetch-player-news.mjs used to persist (headline / description / published / type / links.web.href / images[].url). ESPN is unreachable from CI and from the dev sandbox (egress policy 403s every espn.com host), so this file IS the parser's contract. Rows 4-8 are adversarial on purpose - see tests/player-news.test.ts.

articles.headline: Chase active, expected to play full snap count
articles.description: The Bengals receiver was a full participant Friday and carries no injury designation into Sunday.

articles.headline: Chase posts 9-141-2 in divisional win
articles.description: A season high in yards, and his second multi-touchdown game in three weeks.

articles.headline: Bengals list Chase as limited Wednesday
articles.description: Coach called it maintenance, not a new injury.

articles.headline: Article with a hostile link
articles.description: The href must be rejected but the story must survive.

articles.headline: Article with no link at all
Article with no type and no description

articles.description: This row has no headline and must be dropped entirely.

articles.headline: Article with an unparseable published date
articles.description: Must not become NaN, and must sort last rather than poisoning the compare.
